items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: but I played with him with the Royal American show. Eddie Carl, trauma player, good old, good musician, man.

ctx.x: Well, he was on the, what do you know, he played on that show too. But I mean, I wasn't there when he played there, but I played with him with the Royal American show. Eddie Carl, trauma player, good old, good musician, man. He used to read, you sit down there and read the trumpet parts. Look over there and play the trumpet parts. Yeah. Eddie Carl, that was his name.
I just found a note about Al Wynn and Eddie Carnes. Carnes?
